header.description: What: Simulated devices SD-S4 (DESIGN_Simulated_Devices 3.13b D-93 / D-94 / D-95 / D-96 / D-112). A scripted trainee possesses the Gunner of a TOW tripod with a SIGHT UNIT (TKB 619, the launcher authored with ONE round), binds his view to the unit and holds the crosshair on a hostile man 700 m away. He presses FIRE before POWER, POWER, ARM before the self-test ends, ARM; a FIRE inside a 60-frame pause; FIRE on a live frame; and, once the flight has ended, ARM and FIRE again on the emptied launcher. Judge: (1) the unit's own state (FireControlUnitState) follows OFF, TEST, STANDBY, ARMED, GUIDING, STANDBY; (2) nothing is launched before FIRE on a live armed unit - FIRE early (OFF) and FIRE in the pause (READY off) are refused and never remembered; (3) the weapon's controller fires the missile from the device (D-94), the round is the device's by seq echo (D-95) and flies the device's sight line (D-96) onto the man; (4) the unit never arms an emptied launcher (D-112). Not judged yet: the unit's HUD (panels 7-10) - it waits for the HUD projector. Fail: a launch before ARMED, a launch in the pause, a miss, or ARMED after the flight. Check: scripts/scenario-regression.sh dv-sight-procedure
